title: Hunt for TABL changes
description: This query helps hunting for Tenant allow/block list (TABL) changes in Defender for Office 365
query: ('Log Source' = 'Microsoft 365 Cloud App Events' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Application Logs') and (Action like '*TenantAllowBlockListItems*') | sort -Time
